---
name: Piece Request
about: Suggest a new Action or Condition for the BlockCreator Library
title: '[PIECE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Piece Name**
A concise name for the Piece (e.g. "Trigger Earthquake", "Mario is riding Yoshi").

**Kind**
- [ ] Action (executes behavior when the block is touched)
- [ ] Condition (evaluates true/false check for an `if` branch)

**Applicable Slots**
- [ ] Mario (Top, Bottom, Sides, Inside)
- [ ] Sprites
- [ ] Any

**Description of Behavior**
What should this Piece do in Super Mario World?

**SMW RAM Addresses / Routines (if known)**
Are there specific SMW RAM addresses (e.g. `$1887`, `$1490`), sprite tables, or standard GPS routines involved?

**Parameters**
Should the user be able to customize values (e.g. sound effect ID, timer duration, direction)?
